steps.text: The generation is displayed with a green dot indicating it completed successfully. The delete button (×) at the top right of the row allows deleting the entire generation and all its keys.
steps.title: Generation completed

steps.text: Click the × button on the generation to initiate its deletion. All associated keys will also be deleted. A confirmation will be required.
steps.title: Delete the generation

steps.text: A confirmation dialog appears. Click the confirm button to permanently delete the generation and all the allocation keys it contains.
steps.title: Confirm deletion

steps.text: Confirm your choice in the confirmation dialog.
steps.title: Confirm

steps.text: The generations list is empty again — the generation and all its allocation keys have been permanently deleted.
steps.title: Generation deleted
